source: English names of the same ten roulette ids as data/roulettes/cn.json, copied from the English ContentRoulette Category text that tools/duty-data-generator/game_names.py fetched from XIVAPI into data/i18n/game-names.2026-10-15.json (roulettes, en). Not cross-checked against a GLOBAL client capture. Display data only: it never identifies a roulette and never makes a protocol profile usable. The roulette names are FINAL FANTASY XIV game text, © SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD., used for non-commercial display under the FINAL FANTASY XIV Materials Usage License with attribution.

provenance.note: The ids are the ones data/roulettes/cn.json carries; the wire evidence for them is the CN client's (protocol-profiles/cn/cn.2026.08.05.json). Each name equals the en entry of the same id in data/i18n/game-names.2026-10-15.json, and ReferenceCatalogTests pins that agreement. An earlier version of this file used community wording and carried Normal Raids and Alliance Raids against the wrong ids (15 is Alliance Raids, 17 is Normal Raids), and gave ids 2 and 8 names the client does not use. This file is presentation-only -- it never identifies a roulette on the wire and never makes a protocol profile usable.
